Running it
----------
simcity.d88 is a bootable disk image for the Sharp X1 Turbo Z. Put it in
the first drive and reset the machine.

The game uses the Turbo Z's 320 x 200, 64-colour graphics mode. The Amiga
map tiles and toolbar art are loaded from the disk at startup. Cities are
saved to and loaded from the disk.

Keys
----
  Cursor keys     move the cursor one square (shifted: eight)
  O P Q A         left, right, up, down
  Space, Enter    build with the tool
  , .             the previous and next tool
  0 - 9           choose a tool by its number
  H               pause or run
  + -             faster, slower
  M               the next mini map (X goes back to the city)
  B               the budget            V   the evaluation
  S               save the city         L   load a city
  X               the game menu: new city, options, disasters
